u0: Initial stage: the agent is holding the box and no fall has occurred yet. Objective: reach the green exit for success. If the box falls, the new obligation is to toggle the wall switch on that same step or afterward; a toggle made before the fall does not count. A fall without a simultaneous toggle moves the task to u1.
u1: The box has fallen and no switch toggle has happened since the fall, so the fall-recovery requirement is unresolved. The box may still be on the floor or may have been picked up again; holding it does not clear the requirement. Current objective: go to the switch, face it, and toggle it at least once to move to u2. Reaching the exit before toggling does not complete the reward-machine goal.
u2: The box has fallen and a qualifying switch toggle has been made after the fall or on the fall step, so the fall-and-switch obligation is satisfied. The box may now be in hand or lying on the floor. Current objective: go to the green exit; if the setup requires the box in hand, recover it first. Reaching the exit from here completes the task.
u3: Terminal success state: the exit has been reached and the reward-machine goal is complete, either with no unresolved fall or after the fall-and-toggle requirement was satisfied. The box may or may not be in hand depending on whether it had fallen. No further action is needed; the episode is over.
